## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: distraction, road rage, fatigue, health, impairment, external passengers and equipment failures
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The extracted text of physical page ninety-one repeats the health, hearing and impaired driving paragraphs of the previous page after its own medicine, implied consent and open container text; facts cite each paragraph only once, from the page where it first appears [A04].
The implied consent refusal penalty is stated only as a possible fine or suspension; no amount or suspension length is printed, so none is taught [A04].
The two outside fuel economy websites listed on the fuel saving page are not followed or quoted [A07].
The sample test questions page (physical page ninety-five) is official question text and is not reproduced or paraphrased into facts.
No dynamic values appear in these pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.
